key_terms.الْم: Disjointed letters (Alif, Lam, Mim) appearing at the start of certain Quranic surahs.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the disjointed letters Alif Lam Mim in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the disjointed letters (Al-Huruf al-Muqatta'at) at the start of Surah Luqman are frequently interpreted as divine oaths or abbreviations alluding to the Prophet Muhammad, his Ahl al-Bayt, or the Quran itself, emphasizing the text's inimitability and divine origin. This opening serves as a rhetorical challenge to skeptics, grounding the subsequent wisdom of Luqman in the authority of the Divine Word.
